title: Ghost IDE 1.1.5beta2
massges:
## Ghost ide 1.1.5beta2

- Improved program graphics by removing XML colors and replacing them with the full Gth theme
- Launched the icon theme store and font plugin
- Fixed reported bugs
- Removed most server languages in plugins; you can now install them automatically
- Fixed startup bugs for users who did not know how to install the program
- Added welcome activities for easier installation
